sentences.text:
Pulak Biswas vs Unknown on 19 September, 2023
19.09.2023 C.R.M. (A) 2946 of 2023
 Sl. 9
Court No. 29
 Sourav

In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of  (Allowed) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kotwali  (Paschim Medinipur) Police Station Case No. 196 of 2023 dated  02.03.2023 under Sections 406/420/379/325/354/506 IPC.

And  In the matter of: Pulak Biswas  ....petitioner.
 Mr. Snehansu Majumder  ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Rudradipta Nandy, Ld. APP  Ms. Sonali Das  ...for the State.

1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. No report has yet been received by learned Counsel for the State as submitted when the matter is called.
3. It is submitted by learned Counsel for the petitioner that in obedience to the order dated 09.08.2023, the petitioner had appeared before the I.O. on 17.08.2023 and 27.08.2023.

Taking into consideration the nature of allegation and the circumstances attending and following the transaction, we are of the view that there is no necessity of custodial interrogation of the petitioner in the present case.

4. Regard being had to the facts and submission, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail in the event of his arrest by the Arresting Officer in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case including the conditions that:
i) The petitioner is directed to appear before the I.O.
once in a fortnight on the day and time fixed by the I.O. for the purpose of investigation till submission of Final Form.
